talents.name: Arcane Subtlety
rankDescriptions: Reduces your target's resistance to all your spells by 15 and reduces the threat caused by your Arcane spells by 30%.

talents.name: Arcane Focus
rankDescriptions: Improves your chance to hit with Arcane spells by 2%.

talents.name: Improved Channeling
rankDescriptions: Gives you a 20% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while channeling Arcane Missiles and a 14% chance while casting Arcane Blast.

talents.name: Wand Specialization
rankDescriptions: Increases your damage with Wands by 13%.

talents.name: Magic Absorption
rankDescriptions: Increases all your resistances by 2 and causes all spells you fully resist to restore 1% of your total mana. Cannot trigger more often than 1 time per sec.

talents.name: Arcane Concentration
rankDescriptions: Gives you a 100% chance of entering a Clearcasting state after any damage spell hits a target. The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.

talents.name: Arcane Geometry
rankDescriptions: Increases the range of your Arcane spells by 6 yards.
Increases the effect of your Amplify Magic and Dampen Magic spells by 50%.

talents.name: Arcane Impact
rankDescriptions: Increases the critical strike chance of your Arcane spells by 6%.

talents.name: Arcane Resilience
rankDescriptions: Increases your Armor by an amount equal to 50% of your Intellect.

talents.name: Arcane Shielding
rankDescriptions: Decreases the Mana lost per point of damage taken when your Mana Shield spell is active by 33% and increases the resistances granted by your Mage Armor spell by 50%.

talents.name: Improved Counterspell
rankDescriptions: Your Counterspell also Silences the target for 4 sec.

talents.name: Arcane Meditation
rankDescriptions: Allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

talents.name: Presence of Mind
rankDescriptions: When activated, your next Mage spell with a casting time less than 10 sec becomes an instant cast spell.

talents.name: Arcane Mind
rankDescriptions: Increases your Intellect by 10% and increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane spells by 100%.

talents.name: Arcane Instability
rankDescriptions: Increases the damage done by your spells by 1% and your critical strike chance by 1%.

talents.name: Arcane Power
rankDescriptions: For the next 15 sec, your spells deal 30% more damage while costing 30% more mana to cast.

talents.name: Improved Fireball
rankDescriptions: Reduces the casting time of your Fireball and Frostfire Bolt spells by 0.5 sec.

talents.name: Impact
rankDescriptions: Gives your Fire spells a 10% chance to stun the target for 2 sec.

talents.name: Ignite
rankDescriptions: Your critical strikes from Fire damage spells cause the target to burn for an additional 40% of your spell's damage over 4 sec.

talents.name: Flame Throwing
rankDescriptions: Increases the range of your Fire spells by 6 yards.

talents.name: Wake of Fire
rankDescriptions: Reduces the cooldown of your Fire Blast spell by 2 sec. Killing a non-trivial target increases the critical strike chance of your next Fire Blast cast within 20 sec by 50%.

talents.name: Incineration
rankDescriptions: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire Blast, Ice Lance, Arcane Blast, and Scorch spells by 6%.

talents.name: Improved Flamestrike
rankDescriptions: Increases the critical strike chance of your Flamestrike spell by 15%.

talents.name: Pyroblast
rankDescriptions: Hurls an immense fiery boulder that causes 110 Fire damage and an additional 44 Fire damage over 12 sec.

talents.name: Burning Soul
rankDescriptions: Gives your Fire spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage and reduces the threat caused by your Fire spells by 30%.

talents.name: Improved Scorch
rankDescriptions: Your Scorch spell has a 100% chance to cause your target to be vulnerable to Fire damage. This vulnerability increases all Fire damage you deal to your target by 3% and lasts 30 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

talents.name: Improved Fire Ward
rankDescriptions: Causes your Fire Ward to have a 20% chance to reflect Fire spells while active.

talents.name: Master of Elements
rankDescriptions: Your Fire and Frost critical strikes will refund 10% of their base mana cost.

talents.name: Critical Mass
rankDescriptions: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire spells by 2%.

talents.name: Blast Wave
rankDescriptions: A wave of flame radiates outward from the caster, damaging all enemies caught within the blast for 163 Fire damage, and Dazing them for 50% reduced movement speed for 6 sec.

talents.name: Fire Power
rankDescriptions: Increases the damage done by your Fire spells by 2%.

talents.name: Combustion
rankDescriptions: When activated, this spell causes each of your Fire damage spell hits to increase your critical strike chance with Fire damage spells by 10%. This effect lasts until you have caused non-periodic critical strikes with Fire spells.

talents.name: Frost Warding
rankDescriptions: Increases the Armor and resistance given by your Frost Armor and Ice Armor spells by 15%. In addition, gives your Frost Ward a 10% chance to reflect Frost spells and effects while active.

talents.name: Improved Frostbolt
rankDescriptions: Reduces the casting time of your Frostbolt spell by 0.1 sec.

talents.name: Elemental Precision
rankDescriptions: Improves your chance to hit with Frost and Fire spells by 6%.

talents.name: Ice Shards
rankDescriptions: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Frost spells by 100%.

talents.name: Frostbite
rankDescriptions: Gives your Chill effects a 15% chance to Freeze the target for 5 sec.

talents.name: Improved Frost Nova
rankDescriptions: Reduces the cooldown of your Frost Nova spell by 4 sec.

talents.name: Permafrost
rankDescriptions: Increases the duration of your Chill effects by 33% and reduces the target's speed by an additional 10%.

talents.name: Piercing Ice
rankDescriptions: Increases the damage done by your Frost spells by 2%.

talents.name: Cold Snap
rankDescriptions: Finishes the remaining cooldown on all your other Frost spells.

talents.name: Improved Blizzard
rankDescriptions: Adds a Chill effect to your Blizzard spell. This effect lowers the target's movement speed by 40% for 1.5 sec.

talents.name: Arctic Reach
rankDescriptions: Increases the range of your Frostbolt and Blizzard spells and the radius of your Frost Nova and Cone of Cold spells by 10%.

talents.name: Frost Channeling
rankDescriptions: Reduces the mana cost of your Frost spells by 15% and reduces the threat caused by your Frost spells by 30%.

talents.name: Shatter
rankDescriptions: Increases the critical strike chance of all your spells against Frozen targets by 1%.

talents.name: Ice Block
rankDescriptions: You become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells.

talents.name: Improved Cone of Cold
rankDescriptions: Increases the damage dealt by your Cone of Cold spell by 15%.

talents.name: Winter's Chill
rankDescriptions: Gives your Frost damage spells a X% chance to apply the Winter's Chill effect, which increases the chance your Ice Lance and Frostbolt spells will critically hit the target by 2% for 15 sec. Stacks up to 5 times.

talents.name: Ice Barrier
rankDescriptions: Instantly shields you, absorbing 431 damage. Lasts 1 min. While the shield holds, your spellcasts will not be interrupted or delayed from taking damage.
